purpose: Frozen isolated candidate on 39 inspected development regressions; not independent held-out evaluation

decomposition_probe.human_review_acceptance: 18/18 structural pass AND all five judgments true for each claim, with human reviewer and per-claim notes before 39 cases
decomposition_probe.dataset_status: 18 unique claims from the inspected 39 development cases; not independent held-out data

human_review_acceptance: All applicable rubric items true for every one of the 39 cases; independent reviewer required before integration
promotion: Never automatic; semantic evidence and independent evaluation required before integration
limitations: All 39 synthetic cases have been inspected and used for development. Independent annotation is pending.
Code validates structure/quotes/arithmetic; semantic decomposition, association and population completeness still depend on the model.
Candidate changes prompting, call count, output contract and token budget together; improvements cannot be attributed to one change.
More than seven parts or repeated repairs may exhaust the eight-call case budget; incomplete results fail the gate.
English AND/simple numerical grammar can reject valid evidence. Gold-support rejection is reported.

Decomposition is limited to English AND and simple temporal/dataset phrases. Only explicit leading scope prefixes are shared; unrepresentable multiple restrictions stop before generation. A full no-AND quote does not prove semantic atomicity.
Independent quantities use occurrence-based requirements with immediate English unit/count nouns. Every requirement needs a separate cited check; compound or ambiguous binding still requires review.
Cost USD is unavailable; actual calls/latency and available generation token counts are recorded.
Shared backend adds a default-empty generation hook; constrained decoding is enabled only by the isolated atomic loader, not serving.
Schema decoding prevents many formatting/source/quantifier errors; semantic entailment, binding and coverage still require validation/review. Token limits can truncate JSON.
Constrained source enums cover at most 80 whitespace-separated claim words; longer claims stop with an explicit backend error.
No serving integration, Reader requests or automatic promotion in this experiment.

Complete metric predicate constraints cover only supported positive duration/count forms. Sharing this requirement with decoder enums prevents those fragments but does not establish semantic entailment or guarantee a passed probe. Two attempts and mandatory review of every actual prediction remain unchanged.

Absolute monotonic case deadline forwarded through RecordingBackend to a per-decode-step Transformers stopping criterion. Late parsed or invalid JSON is rejected with deadline_exceeded; partial generation and call logs are retained. Preparation checks the same deadline. This is cooperative and cannot interrupt a hung CUDA kernel; the hard process watchdog remains.

Assessment context is capped at 600 words before any model call. Source passage choices are bounded to 384 characters, member spans to eight words/160 characters, explanation to 128 characters and missing information to four 160-character items. Unsupported context stops explicitly; finite arrays may still exceed the unchanged token budget.
V8 fixes assessment/repair/numeric/deadline together. No new model inference, human approval, independent validation or production readiness is implied by local regression.
The 12-case assessment smoke is an additional development diagnostic. It does not replace the fresh 18-claim probe review or the mandatory full39 gate.

assessment_smoke.purpose: All 12 original inspected development contracts, not independent validation or full39 admission.
